title: Fear in one shorter sitting
subtitle: A shorter sitting for when fear is already close
description: A short return for the hour when the body is already braced. It steadies fear before it becomes the weather of the whole room.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Fear loses authority when care and remembrance regain the body.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When fear starts ruling the body, stand still long enough to remember what holds you.
